import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    b = p[3] + p[4]/T + p[5]*T
    n = p[6] + p[7]/T
    return a + b*eps**n + p[8]*eps + p[9]*eps**2

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]*np.log(T)
    b = p[4] + p[5]/T
    c = p[6] + p[7]/T
    return a + b*np.sqrt(eps) + c*eps + p[8]*eps**1.5 + p[9]*eps**2/T
